name: Nine-banded armadillo
desc: Nine-banded armadillo (Dasypus novemcinctus): hunts or scavenges other animals. Recorded 10 times near the park in GBIF.
about: The nine-banded armadillo, also called the nine-banded long-nosed armadillo or common armadillo, is a species of armadillo native to South America.
